Weekly announcement for travelers
Someone on the desk wanted you to know

Travel notice for companion animals

Travelers should review their pet plans before departure so our team can keep every carrier secure and every handoff calm.

The senior coordinator reviews each case with care, and the ground team moves carriers carefully between services. If your travel is affected by a delayed departure, the desk will explain the usual assistance for that situation. <<FACT F109>>

Please make sure documents, carrier fittings, and feeding notes are ready when you arrive. Clear labeling and calm handling help us protect the comfort of each animal throughout the journey.

If you need help or want your current arrangements checked, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
